note: A representative set of San Francisco congregations across traditions, listed in no order of importance; the city has hundreds more. Most entries come from directories (SF Station, devout.org, Jewish Baby Network) because congregation websites could not be opened in this pass, so service times are filled only where a congregation's own page or bulletin was read, and directory-only entries are marked for review. No Sikh gurdwara or Hindu temple other than the Vedanta Society was found in sources opened. Few November and December 2026 public events were posted yet; Thanksgiving meals listed under services are based on 2025 reports.

services.name: GLIDE Daily Free Meals
services.what: Free breakfast, lunch and dinner; no eligibility requirements or intake form. About 1,700 meals a day, 364 days a year.
services.when: Breakfast 7:30 to 9 am (7:30 to 8 am reserved for seniors, families and adults with disabilities); lunch 11:30 am to 1 pm including weekends; dinner 3:30 to 5 pm, Monday to Sunday
services.note: Run by GLIDE. GLIDE has served an annual Thanksgiving meal (11 am start in 2025) and Christmas Eve and Christmas Day meals in past years.
services.review_note: Thanksgiving and Christmas 2026 plans not posted on pages opened; 2025 Thanksgiving detail from Mission Local (https://missionlocal.org/2025/11/where-san-franciscans-can-find-a-free-thanksgving-dinner/).
